page: Amazon Web Services m8id.24xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. It features 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance across multiple domains. Multi-core processing is highly efficient, with Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression scores placing in the top 10%. The DDR5 memory subsystem delivers top-tier read-only bandwidth for both small and large blocks. In database and application workloads, the instance achieves top-tier results in Passmark database operations, static web serving throughput, and Redis SET operations. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core results falling in the middle 50%.

The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations. These hardware accelerators contribute to top-tier prompt processing speeds in LLM inference benchmarks, though text generation speeds remain in the average to strong range. Given the high-capacity local NVMe storage, balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, and strong multi-core capabilities, this instance is well-suited for high-throughput database operations, software compilation, web serving, and data-intensive general-purpose workloads.
